description: Metro de Panamá - Kilometraje de Trenes del 2018 a 2026 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Información sobre los kilómetros acumulados de material rodante por mes y número de tren para la Línea 1 y Línea 2 del Metro de Panamá en los años 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 y 2026. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. Its tags are Datos anuales, Datos mensuales, kilometros acumulados, línea 1 y línea 2, material rodante. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
